facts: Actuators (arx5-sdk X5 config): J1–J3 EC-A4310, J4–J6 DM-J4310, gripper DM-J4310.
EC-A4310-P2-36: Ø56 × 60.5 mm, 382 g, 36:1, 12 N·m rated / 36 N·m peak, 1.4 N·m/A, dual encoders.
DM-J4310-2EC: Ø56 × 46 mm, 300 g, 10:1, 3 N·m rated / 7 N·m peak, two 14-bit magnetic encoders.
SDK software limits: torque 30 / 40 / 30 / 15 / 10 / 10 N·m; gripper width 88 mm, 1.5 N·m max.
Gripper: rack-and-pinion; both fingers ride MGN9-size carriages (20 × 28.9 mm) on one rail; each finger travels 0–44 mm (X5A URDF).
Hardware found as separate solids in ARX CAD: 18 × M3×16 socket head cap screw, 18 × M1.6×3 socket head cap screw, 3 × Ø2 × 4 dowel pin
